input.instruction: Complete a document-conflict handoff, not a claim or payout form. Disposition reflects the need for staff reconciliation; missing_fields should not list unavailable internal decisions as customer prerequisites. Fill exactly the specified document fields from the supplied conversation and records. Normalize dates to ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Copy names, addresses, emails, and identifiers with the spelling supplied. This is an extraction-only task; actions must be empty. In the response distinguish drafting from execution.

messages.text: I downloaded two declarations for the same policy term. One says a $250 deductible and the other says $1,000. Which one should I put on the claim worksheet?
Does either document say it replaces the other, or have you received an endorsement?
Neither says superseded. They both show the same issue date and policy dates. I have no endorsement or notice explaining it.
Would you prefer the lower figure?
Of course, but preference is not evidence. Please have staff reconcile the documents instead of guessing.
What contact should go on the handoff, and should I calculate a possible payment now?
Use sol.fern@post.example. Do not calculate a payment until the deductible is resolved. I am only asking about the conflicting records today.

policy_id.description: Policy identifier shared by the supplied declarations.

conflicting_deductibles.description: Unordered distinct deductible amounts appearing in equally authoritative applicable declarations, in USD.

resolved_deductible.description: Single authoritative deductible only if the record conflict can be resolved; otherwise null.

conflicting_record_ids.description: Unordered supplied record IDs that create the unresolved conflict.

payment_calculation_requested.description: True for a current payment illustration request; false if expressly declined.
